text:
## PART 6: FRAUD PREVENTION MEASURES  
### Prevention Actions by Fraud Type  
**Account Takeover Prevention:**
- Enforce password complexity requirements
- Implement 2FA on all accounts
- Monitor for login anomalies
- Educate customers on phishing  
**Card Fraud Prevention:**
- Issue chip/contactless cards only
- Enable card alerts (SMS for transactions >£X)
- Implement velocity checks (max transactions per day)
- Require customer authentication for high-value transactions  
**Impersonation Prevention:**
- Enhanced KYC verification
- Document original ID verification
- Monitor for duplicate IDs
- Flag suspicious patterns  
**Check Fraud Prevention:**
- Implement positive pay (customer specifies issued checks)
- Require additional verification for large checks
- Monitor check clearing times (unusual delays = red flag)

raw_entities.description: A comprehensive set of prevention measures categorized by fraud type, including Account Takeover, Card Fraud, Impersonation, and Check Fraud. The process defines specific technical controls and verification requirements to mitigate fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Password Complexity Enforcement
raw_entities.description: A security measure within Account Takeover Prevention requiring the enforcement of password complexity standards.

raw_entities.name: Two-Factor Authentication Implementation
raw_entities.description: The mandatory implementation of 2FA across all customer accounts to prevent account takeover.

raw_entities.name: Login Anomaly Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Continuous monitoring of account login patterns to identify anomalies indicative of account takeover.

raw_entities.name: Customer Phishing Education
raw_entities.description: Educational outreach provided to customers to help them recognize and avoid phishing attempts.

raw_entities.name: Chip and Contactless Card Issuance
raw_entities.description: A card fraud prevention measure restricting card issuance exclusively to chip and contactless technology.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Card Alert Setup
raw_entities.description: Enabling SMS alerts for transactions that exceed a specific monetary threshold (£X) to prevent card fraud.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Velocity Checking
raw_entities.description: Implementation of system checks to limit the maximum number of transactions allowed per day per card.
context: Implement velocity checks (max transactions per day)

raw_entities.name: High-Value Transaction Authentication
raw_entities.description: Requirement for explicit customer authentication when a transaction is flagged as high-value.
context: Require customer authentication for high-value transactions

raw_entities.name: Enhanced KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: A rigorous KYC process used specifically to prevent impersonation fraud.

raw_entities.name: Original ID Document Verification
raw_entities.description: The verification of original identification documents to prevent fraud by impersonation.

raw_entities.name: Duplicate ID Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A check performed to identify if the same identification document is being used across multiple applications/accounts.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Pattern Flagging
raw_entities.description: The process of identifying and flagging patterns of behavior that suggest impersonation attempts.

raw_entities.name: Positive Pay Implementation
raw_entities.description: A check fraud prevention measure where customers must specify the checks they have issued for the bank to validate.
context: Implement positive pay (customer specifies issued checks)

raw_entities.name: Large Check Additional Verification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory additional verification steps required for the processing of large-value checks.
context: Require additional verification for large checks

raw_entities.name: Check Clearing Time Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The monitoring of the time it takes for checks to clear, where unusual delays are treated as red flags for fraud.
context: Monitor check clearing times (unusual delays = red flag)

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer who is the subject of fraud prevention measures and is required to provide authentication or specify issued checks.
context: Require customer authentication for high-value transactions

raw_entities.name: High-Value Transaction Authentication Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision point triggered by high-value transactions requiring customer authentication before the transaction can proceed.
context: Require customer authentication for high-value transactions

raw_entities.name: Check Clearing Delay Red Flag
raw_entities.description: An exception trigger where unusual delays in check clearing are flagged as potential fraud.
